summary: The single typed task60 command, producer, completion and lower-read owner.

rows.shim: xm1_loading_configure, xm1_loading_absolute_deadline, xm1_loading_initialize, xm1_loading_request, xm1_loading_request_sync, xm1_loading_cancel and xm1_loading_wait_channel
rows.kind: C-ABI bridge between two owned units
rows.other_side: startup construction and Develop loading callers
rows.removal: all callers use the Rust API in one final composition

evidence.requirement: Startup supplies a required absolute-deadline provider on the qualified clock before initialization; every request carries that one deadline unchanged through read and cleanup. No duration or default is fitted here. Abort argument 0x91482c remains a task argument, not policy storage.

rows.shim: task60 queue, task, wait, signal and current-task leaves
rows.other_side: retained RTOS message and semaphore services
rows.removal: the kernel owns typed queue and wait APIs

evidence.requirement: Queue60 retains the source 48-byte capacity and 16-message depth. The 24-byte envelope carries the original absolute deadline.

rows.shim: NAND, decoder, segment, extent, progress and delegated-command leaves
rows.other_side: retained X-M1 services and the owned image5 decoder component
rows.removal: the corresponding device and delegated command units are owned

evidence.requirement: The DMA unit is fixed at 0x20000 bytes. Plain backing is 0x360000 bytes and image5 staging is 0x2e0000 bytes; 0x100000 remains a controller budget, not a lease extent.
